description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for a seeded memory card game. It includes data models for creating and responding to game sessions, fetching the deck, and attempting card matches. It also sets up API routes for creating a game, retrieving the current deck, and processing match attempts, utilizing an underlying service class.

classes.name: CreateGameRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new seeded game session, with optional difficulty and seed.

classes.name: CreateGameResponse
classes.description: Response model containing game metadata after creation, including game ID, seed, difficulty, total cards/pairs, move count, and completion status.

classes.name: Card
classes.description: Model representing a card's ID and face value, excluding matched state.

classes.name: MatchRequest
classes.description: Model representing the payload with two card IDs to attempt matching.

classes.name: MatchResponse
classes.description: Model reflecting the result of a match attempt, including whether it was successful, remaining pairs, move count, and completion status.

methods.name: CreateGameResponse create_game(payload: CreateGameRequest = Body(default=CreateGameRequest()))
methods.description: API endpoint to initiate a new game session, returning game metadata.

methods.name: List[Card] get_deck(gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Game session ID"))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the current state of the game deck, excluding matched state.

methods.name: MatchResponse post_match( gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Game session ID"), payload: MatchRequest = Body(...), )
methods.description: API endpoint to process a match attempt between two cards, updating game state and returning match result.
